units.source_text: 母亲恰巧站在那块写上"违者将依国法惩罚"几个字的告示牌旁。

en.t: Mother happened to be standing beside the signboard that read "Violators will be punished according to national law."

units.source_text: 在门灯的映照下，她那蓬乱的头发，恍如一根根倒竖着的白毫。

en.t: In the glow of the gate lamp, her disheveled hair looked like strands of fine white down standing on end.

units.source_text: 母亲的头发还不至于那么白，只是在灯光的映照下显得白花花而且。

en.t: Mother's hair was not yet that white; it only looked pale and glaring under the lamplight.

units.source_text: 她的头发笼盖下的小小面孔毫无表情。

en.t: The small face covered by her hair was utterly expressionless.
